def: a desert-dweller, i.e. nomad or wild beast
kjv: wild beast of the desert, that dwell in (inhabiting) the wilderness.

words.word: they that dwell in the wilderness
but wild beasts of the desert
it for them that dwell in the wilderness
the wild beasts of the desert
therefore the wild beasts of the desert

occurrences.text: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.
words: They that dwell in the wilderness

occurrences.text: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.
words: But wild beasts of the desert

occurrences.text: Behold the land of the Chaldeans; this people was not, till the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness: they set up the towers thereof, they raised up the palaces thereof; and he brought it to ruin.
words: it for them that dwell in the wilderness

occurrences.text: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.
words: The wild beasts of the desert

occurrences.text: Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell there, and the owls shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.
words: Therefore the wild beasts of the desert
